root_cause_classification.reason: SLM-CPU-070 removed the worst repeated per-weight scale decode pattern, but the real SLM-CPU-072 six-prompt receipt still regressed in prefill and decode while tokenization and sampling were flat or slightly lower. The remaining packed sidecar path still converts Candle tensors into host Vec<f32> inputs, allocates a fresh output Vec<f32>, runs scalar non-vectorized and non-parallel matvec loops, and replaces only one exact Q projection tensor. That combination makes the opt-in sidecar slower than eager_f32_candle despite preserving generated IDs and text.

next_target.title: packed Q8 sidecar matvec instrumentation and scratch-elimination gate
requirements: Keep eager_f32_candle as the default runtime.
Keep packed sidecar execution opt-in and exact-tensor scoped to layers.0.attention.q_proj.weight.
Measure or eliminate input flatten/to_vec, output Vec allocation, and bias extraction costs before adding broader packed-Q8 runtime selection.

Add per-call or aggregate timing counters around sidecar input materialization, packed matvec compute, output tensor construction, and selector dispatch so the next artifact separates memory movement from arithmetic.
Preserve identical model SHA, tokenizer source and strictness, prompt IDs, generated IDs, decoded text, selected CPU backend identity, dense hook identity, and fallback_used=false.
Do not claim speedup unless a separate bounded before/after timing artifact proves it.

decision.claim_allowed: The exact-tensor packed Q8_0 sidecar is behavior-equivalent but slower on the bounded six-prompt 4-thread i5-8250U artifact; the next target is memory-movement and scalar-matvec instrumentation/elimination, not promotion.

claim_boundary: This artifact localizes only the committed SLM-CPU-072 six-prompt two-repeat 4-thread i5-8250U receipts after the SLM-CPU-070 block-local matvec prototype.
The exact-tensor packed Q8_0 sidecar remains opt-in and is not enabled by default.
Behavior equivalence is preserved for the compared receipts.
No speedup, sustained throughput, broad answer quality, Q4/Q5 runtime support, server, GPU, NPU, OpenVINO, UHD 620, Qwen3.5, or BitNet QK256 claim is made.
